bounds.domain: One saved credential, one host, original acknowledgement deadline 2, logical time 0..3. Six initial states cover acknowledged/unacknowledged, active/inactive, matching/mismatching binding.
bounds.transitions: Quiescent public resume/cancel/disconnect/restart operations, eight resume and nine cancellation outcomes, plus cancellation at five explicit resume await boundaries. Storage failures before/after atomic commit and remote effects with lost replies are distinct. The five race transitions assume cancellation itself succeeds.
bounds.assumptions: Receipt is already durably saved. Atomic authenticated server acknowledgement/revocation, atomic local file replacement, cooperative activation guard, no concurrent host process or new credential replacement. Cryptography, issuance, verified-owner callback and external storage durability are separate contracts. The acknowledged key remains unexpired through the model horizon.
bounds.progress: RetriedCancellationCompletes assumes weak fairness of a complete successful cancellation retry, including eventual network and storage success. No completion claim for permanent outage, expired unacknowledged enrollment, or absent retry.

assumptions: Checked formula in NativeEnrollmentRecovery: RetriedCancellationCompletes = cancel(false, "none").weakFair(s).implies( always((s.durable.pending == "revocation").implies(eventually( s.durable.pending == "none" and not(s.durable.active)))))
The property is conditional on its written model fairness and environmental premises. Real scheduler fairness, provider completion and implementation refinement are not proved.
